schema:name: Enable patient control and consent-based sharing of health information
schema:description:
This subgoal focuses on empowering individuals to manage access to their health data through granular, explicit consent mechanisms. It transitions the health ecosystem toward a model where patients govern who sees their information and for what purpose.

The objective is to ensure ethical data use and comply with legal requirements for informed consent. It builds systemic trust by providing patients with agency and digital empowerment over their personal health journey.

A citizen using a digital dashboard to grant a specialist temporary access to their specific lab results for a consultation.
